title: A bill to designate the United States courthouse located at 111 South Highland Avenue in Jackson, Tennessee, as the "James D. Todd United States Courthouse", and for other purposes.
official_summary: This act designates the U.S. courthouse located at 111 South Highland Avenue in Jackson, Tennessee, as the James D. Todd United States Courthouse.

summary.headline: Names a federal courthouse in Jackson, Tennessee, after former federal judge James D. Todd.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the United States courthouse at 111 South Highland Avenue in Jackson, Tennessee, as the James D. Todd United States Courthouse. It does not change how the court operates or what cases it hears. The official summary describes only this designation.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2022, and the designation took effect on that date.
